t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The advice I recieved says the gnomes are always in the same pairings although their position may swittch. Some gnomes will lead me to the bright forest and others will lead me to a dark forest. I need to figure out which forest gives me more mushrooms and always go to that forest, especially on x5 rounds. The other features of the gnomes, like their size, are irrelevant. This advice comes from a participant who previously completed the game.

vb_textbox.text: In this game, gnomes always come in the same pairs. Blue and purple, orange and brown, green and pink and red and yellow. Some gnomes take you to a forest with a yellow basket and others take you to a forest with a red basket. The forest with the most mushrooms will vary throughout the game, so try to see which one is doing better.My biggest piece of advice is to remain focused. I lost points because at times I though I had pressed a key when I hadn't, so I was too slow to earn any mushrooms.Best of luck to you!
